summary: NRx Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K announcing its intention to conduct an underwritten public offering of common stock, with BTIG as lead bookrunner and Lucid Capital Markets as joint bookrunner. The offering includes a 30-day underwriter option for an additional 15% of shares. Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. The offering is subject to market conditions and will be made under an existing effective shelf registration statement (Form S-3). As a routine capital-raising announcement without a definitive price, size, or timeline, this is not a special situation but an ordinary public offering filing. Investors should watch for the prospectus supplement for final terms.
